question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (1) **'provides'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Let's take a look at the phrase: **This book (1) _______ writing practice to pre-schoolers to help them,
 
• **Let's take a look at the options:**
 
• The subject of the sentence is singular ("Select"), so we need a singular verb.
 
• **"Provides"** is the correct singular form of the verb. - "Provide" is the plural form of the verb, so it would be incorrect in this sentence. -
 
• **"Is providing" **is the present continuous tense, which suggests an ongoing action. This tense would not make sense in this context. -
 
• **"Had provided" **is the past perfect tense, which suggests an action that was completed before another past action. This tense would also not make sense in this context.
 
• Having explained the options we find** 'provides'** will be the most appropriate option for the given blank.
 
• The complete phrase will be: ***This book provides__ writing practice to pre-schoolers to help them,***

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2,** "provide"**, is the plural form of the verb and would not be correct with a singular subject. 
 
• Option 3, **"is providing"**, suggests an ongoing action and does not fit the context of the sentence. 
 
• Option 4,** "had provided"**, suggests a completed action in the past and does not fit the context of the sentence.
